description: This file defines the DetailedLeaveRequest class, which handles leave request related calculations, manages associated leave entities, computes leave durations, periods, balances, and manages allowed workflow actions within an HR management system.

classes.name: DetailedLeaveRequest
classes.description: A class responsible for managing leave request calculations, associated leave entities, periods, balances, and workflow actions within an HR system.

methods.name: setLeaveRequest
methods.description: Sets the LeaveRequest object and resets internal caches.

methods.name: fetchLeaves
methods.description: Fetches all leaves related to the current leave request.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Returns the list of leaves, sorted by date.

methods.name: setLeaves
methods.description: Sets the leave list and initializes leave dates, throwing an exception if input is empty.

methods.name: addLeave
methods.description: Adds a single leave to the list and resets caches.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of leave entries.

methods.name: getNoOfDays
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of leave days.

methods.name: getDatesDetail
methods.description: Provides detailed date information about the leave request.

methods.name: getLeaveBreakdown
methods.description: Returns a breakdown of leave statuses and lengths, excluding weekends and holidays.

methods.name: getLeaveBalances
methods.description: Retrieves leave balances across leave periods for an employee and leave type.

methods.name: getLeavePeriods
methods.description: Calculates and returns the leave periods and first leave of each period.

methods.name: hasMultipleStatus
methods.description: Checks if the leave request has multiple status types.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Returns allowed actions based on current leave statuses and workflows.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflows
methods.description: Fetches the list of allowed workflow actions for a given leave status.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific action is permitted for the current leave request.

methods.name: getWorkflowForAction
methods.description: Provides the workflow state associated with a specific action.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the leave request if it has a single status.
